# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# games_myth.R -- Mythological & Adventure slot definitions.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

no_cls <- function(def) matrix("", def$rows, def$reels)
no_badge <- function(def) matrix("", def$rows, def$reels)

# Average bet over a collection period (meters pay on average bet so that
# collecting at low stakes and cashing in at high stakes is not exploitable).
avg_bet <- function(gs, key, bet) {
  n <- gs[[paste0(key, "_n")]] %||% 0
  s <- gs[[paste0(key, "_sum")]] %||% 0
  if (n <= 0) bet else s / n
}
track_bet <- function(gs, key, bet) {
  gs[[paste0(key, "_n")]] <- (gs[[paste0(key, "_n")]] %||% 0) + 1
  gs[[paste0(key, "_sum")]] <- (gs[[paste0(key, "_sum")]] %||% 0) + bet
  gs
}
reset_bet <- function(gs, key) {
  gs[[paste0(key, "_n")]] <- 0; gs[[paste0(key, "_sum")]] <- 0; gs
}

# ---- 7. Purrymid Prince ---------------------------------------------------------
# Expanding cat-pharaoh wilds (reels 2-4) + Tomb Raid trail bonus (3+ scarabs).
tomb_level <- function(level, bet) {
  k <- if (level == 1) 3 else 2
  vals <- sample(c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6), k, replace = TRUE) * level * bet
  kinds <- c(rep("coin", k), if (level > 1) "trap")
  values <- c(vals, if (level > 1) 0)
  labels <- c(fmt_coins(vals), if (level > 1) paste("\U0001F9DF", tr("MUMMY")))
  o <- sample.int(3)
  bonus_tiles(kinds[o], values[o], labels[o])
}

game_purrymid <- function() {
  make_slot(
    id = "purrymid", name = "Purrymid Prince", category = "myth",
    tagline = "Expanding cat-pharaoh wilds & a tomb-raiding trail",
    description = paste(
      "The Cat Pharaoh is WILD on reels 2, 3 and 4 and expands to cover the whole reel.",
      "Three or more Scarabs start the Tomb Raid: choose one of three doors in each of",
      "four chambers. Treasure doors pay out and lead deeper; the mummy's door ends the",
      "raid. Survive all four for the Pharaoh's treasure (40x bet)."),
    volatility = "Medium", theme = "theme-egypt", art = "\U0001F63C",
    symbols = list(
      sym("cat", "\U0001F63C", "Cat Pharaoh Wild", pays = p3(50, 200, 750), weight = 3, cls = "wild", reels = 2:4),
      sym("eye", "\U0001F441\uFE0F", "Eye of Ra", pays = p3(30, 100, 400), weight = 4),
      sym("ankh", "\u2625", "Ankh", pays = p3(25, 75, 250), weight = 5, cls = "gold-glyph"),
      sym("urn", "\U0001F3FA", "Canopic Urn", pays = p3(20, 50, 200), weight = 6),
      sym("pyramid", "\U0001F53A", "Pyramid", pays = p3(15, 40, 150), weight = 7),
      royal("A", p3(8, 25, 80), 10), royal("K", p3(6, 20, 60), 11),
      royal("Q", p3(5, 15, 50), 12), royal("J", p3(4, 12, 40), 13),
      sym("scarab", "\U0001FAB2", "Scarab", weight = 3.5, cls = "scatter")
    ),
    wild = "cat", scatter = "scarab", scatter_pays = c(0, 0, 2, 10, 50), n_lines = 20,
    features = c("Expanding wilds", "Tomb Raid trail bonus"),
    play = function(ctx) {
      def <- ctx$def
      grid <- spin_grid(def)
      frames <- list()
      wr <- which(colSums(grid == "cat") > 0)
      if (length(wr)) {
        frames[[1]] <- frame(def, grid)
        cls <- no_cls(def); cls[, wr] <- "expanded"
        grid[, wr] <- "cat"
        ev <- eval_grid(def, grid, ctx$bet, fs_mult = ctx$fs_mult)
        frames[[2]] <- frame(def, grid, ev$hl, cls = cls, win = ev$win, mode = "swap",
                             note = tr("The Pharaoh expands!"))
      } else {
        ev <- eval_grid(def, grid, ctx$bet, fs_mult = ctx$fs_mult)
        frames[[1]] <- frame(def, grid, ev$hl, win = ev$win)
      }
      bonus <- NULL
      if (ev$scatters >= 3) {
        b <- ctx$bet * def$scale
        bonus <- new_bonus("trail", tr("Tomb Raid"), tr("Choose a door in each chamber - avoid the mummy!"),
                           tomb_level(1, b), face = "\U0001F6AA", bet = b,
                           levels = 4L, treasure = 40 * b, make_level = tomb_level)
      }
      slot_result(ctx, ev$win, frames, bonus = bonus, parts = ev$parts,
                  events = c(if (length(wr)) "expanding_wild", if (!is.null(bonus)) "bonus"))
    }
  )
}

# ---- 8. Stone Gold ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Medusa's gaze: every winning symbol turns to stone and locks; the rest respin
# until no new stone appears. The final board pays.
game_stonegold <- function() {
  make_slot(
    id = "stonegold", name = "Stone Gold", category = "myth",
    tagline = "Medusa turns winners to stone for locking respins",
    description = paste(
      "Any win triggers Medusa's gaze: winning symbols turn to stone and lock in place",
      "while every other position respins. Each respin that adds new winning positions",
      "petrifies them too and grants another respin. The final petrified board pays."),
    volatility = "Medium", theme = "theme-stone", art = "\U0001F40D", monster = TRUE,
    symbols = list(
      sym("medusa", "\U0001F40D", "Medusa Wild", pays = p3(40, 150, 600), weight = 3, cls = "wild", reels = 2:5),
      sym("statue", "\U0001F5FF", "Statue", pays = p3(30, 100, 400), weight = 4),
      sym("shield", "\U0001F6E1\uFE0F", "Shield", pays = p3(20, 60, 250), weight = 5),
      sym("sword", "\U0001F5E1\uFE0F", "Sword", pays = p3(15, 50, 200), weight = 6),
      sym("amphora", "\U0001F3FA", "Amphora", pays = p3(12, 40, 150), weight = 7),
      sym("coin", "\U0001FA99", "Gold Coin", pays = p3(10, 30, 100), weight = 8),
      royal("A", p3(6, 20, 60), 10), royal("K", p3(5, 15, 50), 11),
      royal("Q", p3(4, 12, 40), 12), royal("J", p3(4, 10, 30), 13)
    ),
    wild = "medusa", n_lines = 20,
    features = c("Stone lock respins", "Monsterpedia: Medusa's Lair"),
    play = function(ctx) {
      def <- ctx$def
      grid <- spin_grid(def)
      ev <- eval_grid(def, grid, ctx$bet, fs_mult = ctx$fs_mult)
      frames <- list(frame(def, grid, ev$hl, win = ev$win))
      respins <- 0L
      if (ev$win > 0) {
        locked <- ev$hl
        repeat {
          if (all(locked) || respins >= 8) break
          for (c in seq_len(def$reels)) {
            free_rows <- which(!locked[, c])
            grid[free_rows, c] <- draw_cells(def, c, length(free_rows))
          }
          respins <- respins + 1L
          ev <- eval_grid(def, grid, ctx$bet, fs_mult = ctx$fs_mult)
          new_locked <- locked | ev$hl
          cls <- no_cls(def); cls[locked] <- "stone"
          frames[[length(frames) + 1]] <- frame(def, grid, ev$hl, cls = cls, hold = locked,
                                                win = ev$win, mode = "respin",
                                                note = tr("Medusa respin %d", respins))
          if (sum(new_locked) == sum(locked)) break
          locked <- new_locked
        }
        cls <- no_cls(def); cls[locked | ev$hl] <- "stone"
        frames[[length(frames)]]$cls <- cls
      }
      slot_result(ctx, ev$win, frames, parts = ev$parts,
                  events = if (respins > 0) c("stone_respin", "feature") else character(0))
    }
  )
}

# ---- 9. Blackbeard's Riches ------------------------------------------------------------
# Cascading reels + treasure-map progression bonus.
MAP_STEPS <- 15L
MAP_PRIZES <- c(`5` = 5, `10` = 15, `15` = 60)     # x average bet

game_blackbeard <- function() {
  make_slot(
    id = "blackbeard", name = "Blackbeard's Riches", category = "myth",
    tagline = "Cascading reels & a treasure-map voyage",
    description = paste(
      "Winning symbols explode and new ones tumble down - cascades continue as long",
      "as you keep winning. Every Treasure Map that lands (including on cascades) sails",
      "Blackbeard's ship one island further along a 15-island voyage: islands 5 and 10",
      "pay 5x and 15x your average bet, and the treasure island pays 60x."),
    volatility = "Medium", theme = "theme-pirate", art = "\U0001F3F4\u200D\u2620\uFE0F",
    symbols = list(

      sym("parrot", "\U0001F99C", "Parrot", pays = p3(30, 100, 300), weight = 4),
      sym("skull", "\U0001F480", "Skull", pays = p3(20, 60, 200), weight = 5),
      sym("anchor", "\u2693", "Anchor", pays = p3(15, 50, 150), weight = 6),
      sym("sword", "\U0001F5E1\uFE0F", "Cutlass", pays = p3(12, 40, 120), weight = 7),
      royal("A", p3(6, 20, 60), 10), royal("K", p3(5, 15, 50), 11),
      royal("Q", p3(4, 12, 40), 12), royal("J", p3(4, 10, 30), 13),
      sym("map", "\U0001F5FA\uFE0F", "Treasure Map", weight = 3, cls = "collect")
    ),
    n_lines = 20, wild = "flag",
    init_state = list(map = 0L),
    features = c("Cascading reels", "15-island map progression"),
    play = function(ctx) {
      def <- ctx$def; gs <- ctx$gs
      gs <- track_bet(gs, "map", ctx$bet)
      grid <- spin_grid(def)
      maps <- sum(grid == "map")
      total <- 0; parts <- character(0); frames <- list(); casc <- 0L
      ev <- eval_grid(def, grid, ctx$bet, fs_mult = ctx$fs_mult)
      frames[[1]] <- frame(def, grid, ev$hl, win = ev$win)
      while (ev$win > 0 && casc < 12) {
        total <- total + ev$win; parts <- c(parts, ev$parts)
        cs <- cascade_step(def, grid, ev$hl)
        grid <- cs$grid
        maps <- maps + sum(grid == "map" & cs$new)
        casc <- casc + 1L
        ev <- eval_grid(def, grid, ctx$bet, fs_mult = ctx$fs_mult)
        cls <- no_cls(def); cls[cs$new] <- "dropped"
        frames[[length(frames) + 1]] <- frame(def, grid, ev$hl, cls = cls, win = ev$win,
                                              mode = "cascade", note = tr("Cascade %d", casc))
      }
      events <- if (casc > 0) "cascade" else character(0)
      if (maps > 0) {
        old <- gs$map; new <- old + maps
        ab <- avg_bet(gs, "map", ctx$bet)
        for (step in (old + 1):min(new, MAP_STEPS)) {
          key <- as.character(step)
          if (!is.na(MAP_PRIZES[key])) {
            p <- prize(def, MAP_PRIZES[[key]], ab)
            total <- total + p
            parts <- c(parts, tr("Island %d reached: +%s", step, fmt_coins(p)))
            events <- c(events, "bonus")
          }
        }
        if (new >= MAP_STEPS) { new <- new - MAP_STEPS; gs <- reset_bet(gs, "map"); events <- c(events, "map_complete") }
        gs$map <- as.integer(new)
      }
      frames[[length(frames)]]$note <- paste(c(frames[[length(frames)]]$note,
        if (maps > 0) trn(maps, "+%d map", "+%d maps", maps)), collapse = "  ")
      slot_result(ctx, total, frames, gs = gs, parts = parts, events = events)
    },
    meter = function(gs, bet, jackpots = NULL) {
      m <- gs$map %||% 0
      list(list(label = tr("VOYAGE"), text = tr("Island %d / %d", m, MAP_STEPS), pct = 100 * m / MAP_STEPS,
                kind = "map", steps = MAP_STEPS, at = m, marks = as.integer(names(MAP_PRIZES))))
    }
  )
}

# ---- 12. Mighty Phoenix ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 243 ways + Hold & Spin: 6+ fireballs lock with values, 3 respins that reset
# on every new fireball. Fill all 15 for the GRAND.
PHOENIX_VALUES <- c(1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 10, 15, 25)
PHOENIX_VW     <- c(30, 25, 18, 12, 6, 4, 2.5, 1.5)
PHOENIX_JP     <- c(MINI = 10, MINOR = 25, MAJOR = 100, GRAND = 1000)

phoenix_value <- function(n) {
  lab <- character(n); val <- numeric(n)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    u <- runif(1)
    if (u < 0.012) { lab[i] <- "MAJOR"; val[i] <- PHOENIX_JP[["MAJOR"]] }
    else if (u < 0.04) { lab[i] <- "MINOR"; val[i] <- PHOENIX_JP[["MINOR"]] }
    else if (u < 0.10) { lab[i] <- "MINI"; val[i] <- PHOENIX_JP[["MINI"]] }
    else { v <- wdraw(PHOENIX_VALUES, PHOENIX_VW); lab[i] <- paste0(v, "x"); val[i] <- v }
  }
  list(label = lab, value = val)
}

hold_and_spin <- function(def, grid, bet, p_new = 0.075) {
  held <- grid == "fireball"
  vals <- matrix(0, def$rows, def$reels); labs <- matrix("", def$rows, def$reels)
  v <- phoenix_value(sum(held)); vals[held] <- v$value; labs[held] <- v$label
  frames <- list(); respins <- 3L; n <- 0L
  while (respins > 0 && !all(held)) {
    n <- n + 1L
    g <- grid
    hit <- !held & matrix(runif(length(held)) < p_new, def$rows)
    cls <- matrix("", def$rows, def$reels); cls[held] <- "held"
    g[!held] <- "blank"
    if (any(hit)) {
      nv <- phoenix_value(sum(hit)); vals[hit] <- nv$value; labs[hit] <- nv$label
      g[hit] <- "fireball"; held <- held | hit; respins <- 3L
      cls[hit] <- "new-held"
    } else respins <- respins - 1L
    grid <- g
    frames[[n]] <- frame(def, grid, cls = cls, badge = labs, hold = held, mode = "respin",
                         note = tr("Respins left: %d", respins))
  }
  total_x <- sum(vals)
  grand <- all(held)
  if (grand) total_x <- total_x + PHOENIX_JP[["GRAND"]]
  list(frames = frames, win = floor(total_x * bet * def$scale), grand = grand,
       count = sum(held), badge = labs)
}

  make_slot(
    id = "phoenix", name = "Mighty Phoenix", category = "myth",

    description = paste(
      "243 ways to win - matching symbols on adjacent reels from the left pay anywhere",

      royal("A", p3(10, 20, 50), 9), royal("K", p3(8, 15, 40), 10),
      royal("Q", p3(6, 12, 30), 11), royal("J", p3(5, 10, 25), 12),
      royal("10", p3(5, 10, 20), 12),
      sym("fireball", "\U0001F525", "Fireball", weight = 12, cls = "scatter fireball"),
      sym("blank", "", "Blank", weight = 0, cls = "blank")
    ),
    wild = "phoenix", scatter = "fireball", ways = TRUE, ways_unit = 50,
    features = c("243 ways", "Hold & Spin", "Fixed Mini/Minor/Major/Grand"),
    play = function(ctx) {
      def <- ctx$def
      grid <- spin_grid(def)
      ev <- eval_grid(def, grid, ctx$bet, fs_mult = ctx$fs_mult)
      frames <- list(frame(def, grid, ev$hl, win = ev$win))

                          else tr("Hold & Spin: %d fireballs = %s", hs$count, fmt_coins(hs$win)))
        n <- length(frames)
        frames[[n]]$win <- total
        frames[[n]]$note <- if (hs$grand) tr("GRAND JACKPOT!") else tr("Hold & Spin pays %s", fmt_coins(hs$win))
        events <- c("bonus", "hold_spin", if (hs$grand || any(hs$badge %in% c("MINI", "MINOR", "MAJOR"))) "jackpot")
      }
      slot_result(ctx, total, frames, parts = parts, events = events)
    },
    meter = function(gs, bet, jackpots = NULL) {
      lapply(names(PHOENIX_JP), function(t)
        list(label = tr(t), text = fmt_coins(PHOENIX_JP[[t]] * bet), kind = paste0("jp-", tolower(t))))
    }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# slot_registry.R -- the catalogue of all 22 machines + RTP calibration.
#
# `scale` multiplies every pay of a machine (line/ways/scatter pays and fixed
# feature prizes; linked/fixed jackpots are excluded). RTP is linear in
# `scale`, so each value was solved as 0.955 / (return per unit of scale),
# pooling 180k-340k simulated spins per machine from tools/simulate_rtp.R
# (inverse-variance weighted, batch standard errors inflated 1.5x). `rtp` is the resulting expected return,
# `rtp_se` its standard error, `hit` the hit rate and `feat` the share of
# spins with a feature event (100k-spin run).
# Re-run `Rscript tools/simulate_rtp.R all 1e6` after changing any paytable.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

SLOT_CALIBRATION <- read.csv(text = "

jaguar,3.8281,0.955,0.012,0.34,0.5852
vampire,2.5147,0.955,0.0109,0.315,0.0247
", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

.slot_cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

# All slot definitions, built once per R process and cached.
slot_registry <- function() {
  if (is.null(.slot_cache$all)) {
    all <- c(classic_games(), myth_games(), animal_games())
    names(all) <- vapply(all, `[[`, "", "id")
    for (id in names(all)) {
      cal <- SLOT_CALIBRATION[SLOT_CALIBRATION$id == id, ]
      if (nrow(cal)) {
        all[[id]]$scale <- cal$scale
        all[[id]]$rtp <- cal$rtp; all[[id]]$rtp_se <- cal$rtp_se
        all[[id]]$hit <- cal$hit; all[[id]]$feat <- cal$feat
      }
    }
    .slot_cache$all <- all
  }
  .slot_cache$all
}

slot_def <- function(id) slot_registry()[[id]]

# Unnamed on purpose: the result is spliced into bslib navsets / tag lists,
# which reject (or misinterpret) named elements.
slots_in <- function(category) unname(Filter(function(d) d$category == category, slot_registry()))

                     animal = "Animal & Fantasy 3D")

name: src/fct_stats.R
content:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# fct_stats.R -- player statistics and player classification.
#
# Every finished play is appended to a compact "track" kept in the player
# state (so it is saved with the profile, in every storage backend):
#   * a ring buffer of the last STAT_TRACK_CAP plays (time, balance after the
#     play, wager, net result, category);
#   * lifetime aggregates: active play time, balance peak, maximum drawdown,
#     wager and plays per category, wager on high-risk games, sessions.
# From the track we derive
#   * drawdown  -- peak-to-trough fall of the balance (absolute and %),
#   * tendency  -- balance trend, bet trend, loss chasing, streaks,
#   * category  -- favourite game family, stake class and play style,
#   * classification -- a k-nearest-neighbours classifier (own implementation,
#     standardised features) trained on a synthetic set of player archetypes,
#     and a k-means clustering (stats::kmeans) of the community of players
#     stored in the database.
# Everything here is pure R (no Shiny), so it is unit-tested directly.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Categories used by the statistics (slot categories + table/side families).
STAT_CATEGORIES <- c(classic = "Classic & Vegas slots", myth = "Mythological slots",
                     animal = "Animal 3D slots", blackjack = "Blackjack", poker = "Video Poker",
                     roulette = "Roulette", side = "Side games")
STAT_TABLE_CATS <- c("blackjack", "poker", "roulette")
STAT_RISKY_VOL <- c("High", "Medium-High", "Very High")   # "high-risk" slot volatilities
STAT_TRACK_CAP <- 500L      # plays kept in the ring buffer
STAT_IDLE_SECS <- 120       # a gap longer than this is idle time, not play time
STAT_PLAY_SECS <- 5         # time credited for a play that follows an idle gap
STAT_MIN_PLAYS <- 20L       # plays needed before the player is classified
STAT_MAX_SESSIONS <- 20L    # recent sessions kept in the profile

# ---- the track ---------------------------------------------------------------------

stat_zero <- function() stats::setNames(rep(0, length(STAT_CATEGORIES)), names(STAT_CATEGORIES))

track_new <- function(t0 = now_secs()) {
  list(t0 = t0,                                        # time origin (epoch seconds)
       t = numeric(0), bal = numeric(0), wager = numeric(0), net = numeric(0), cat = integer(0),
       n = 0, active = 0, last_t = 0, online = 0,
       peak = 0, max_dd = 0, max_dd_pct = 0,
       wager_cat = stat_zero(), plays_cat = stat_zero(), risky = 0,
       sessions = list())
}

# Category of a play (slot category for slots, else the family).
stat_category <- function(family, category = NULL) {
  cat <- if (identical(family, "slots") && !is.null(category)) category else family
  if (cat %in% names(STAT_CATEGORIES)) cat else "side"
}

# Is a play "high-risk" (high-volatility slot or a double-or-nothing gamble)?
stat_is_risky <- function(family, game) {
  if (identical(game, "double_up")) return(TRUE)
  if (!identical(family, "slots")) return(FALSE)
  d <- slot_registry()[[game]]
  !is.null(d) && isTRUE(d$volatility %in% STAT_RISKY_VOL)
}

# Append one play to the track.
# @param balance coin balance right after the play
track_add <- function(tk, t, balance, wager, win, cat, risky = FALSE) {
  net <- win - wager
  before <- balance - net
  # active play time: gaps up to STAT_IDLE_SECS count, longer gaps are idle
  gap <- if (tk$last_t > 0) t - tk$last_t else Inf
  tk$active <- tk$active + if (is.finite(gap) && gap >= 0 && gap <= STAT_IDLE_SECS) gap else STAT_PLAY_SECS
  tk$last_t <- t
  # peak & drawdown of the balance
  tk$peak <- max(tk$peak, before, balance)
  dd <- tk$peak - balance
  tk$max_dd <- max(tk$max_dd, dd)
  if (tk$peak > 0) tk$max_dd_pct <- max(tk$max_dd_pct, dd / tk$peak)
  # aggregates
  tk$n <- tk$n + 1
  tk$wager_cat[[cat]] <- tk$wager_cat[[cat]] + wager
  tk$plays_cat[[cat]] <- tk$plays_cat[[cat]] + 1
  if (risky) tk$risky <- tk$risky + wager
  # ring buffer (times stored relative to t0, whole seconds)
  keep <- function(v, x) utils::tail(c(v, x), STAT_TRACK_CAP)
  tk$t <- keep(tk$t, round(t - tk$t0))
  tk$bal <- keep(tk$bal, round(balance))
  tk$wager <- keep(tk$wager, round(wager))
  tk$net <- keep(tk$net, round(net))
  tk$cat <- keep(tk$cat, match(cat, names(STAT_CATEGORIES)))
  tk
}

# Rebuild a track from a saved profile (JSON lists); invalid data -> new track.
track_restore <- function(x) {
  tk <- track_new()
  if (!is.list(x)) return(tk)
  num <- function(v, d = 0) { v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(v))); if (length(v) != 1 || is.na(v)) d else v }
  vec <- function(v) { v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(v))); v[is.na(v)] <- 0; v }
  tk$t0 <- num(x$t0, tk$t0)
  cols <- list(t = vec(x$t), bal = vec(x$bal), wager = vec(x$wager), net = vec(x$net), cat = vec(x$cat))
  len <- unique(lengths(cols))
  if (length(len) == 1) {
    n <- min(len, STAT_TRACK_CAP)
    for (k in names(cols)) tk[[k]] <- utils::tail(cols[[k]], n)
    tk$cat <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(tk$cat, 1), length(STAT_CATEGORIES)))
  }
  for (k in c("n", "active", "last_t", "online", "peak", "max_dd", "max_dd_pct", "risky")) tk[[k]] <- max(0, num(x[[k]]))
  tk$n <- max(tk$n, length(tk$bal))
  for (k in c("wager_cat", "plays_cat")) {
    v <- unlist(x[[k]])
    if (length(v)) {
      hit <- intersect(names(v), names(STAT_CATEGORIES))
      tk[[k]][hit] <- pmax(0, suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v[hit])))
      tk[[k]][is.na(tk[[k]])] <- 0
    }
  }
  ss <- Filter(is.list, x$sessions %||% list())
  tk$sessions <- utils::head(lapply(ss, function(s) list(
    start = num(s$start), seconds = num(s$seconds), plays = num(s$plays),
    start_balance = num(s$start_balance), end_balance = num(s$end_balance))), STAT_MAX_SESSIONS)
  tk
}

# Serialisable form of a track (for the saved profile).
track_snapshot <- function(tk) {
  tk$wager_cat <- as.list(tk$wager_cat)
  tk$plays_cat <- as.list(tk$plays_cat)
  tk
}

# Add a finished session (newest first).
track_add_session <- function(tk, start, seconds, plays, start_balance, end_balance) {
  s <- list(start = start, seconds = round(seconds), plays = plays,
            start_balance = round(start_balance), end_balance = round(end_balance))
  tk$sessions <- utils::head(c(list(s), tk$sessions), STAT_MAX_SESSIONS)
  tk$online <- tk$online + round(seconds)
  tk
}

# ---- drawdown ---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Running peak and drawdown of a balance series.
drawdown_series <- function(bal) {
  if (!length(bal)) return(data.frame(bal = numeric(0), peak = numeric(0), dd = numeric(0), dd_pct = numeric(0)))
  peak <- cummax(bal)
  dd <- peak - bal
  data.frame(bal = bal, peak = peak, dd = dd, dd_pct = ifelse(peak > 0, dd / peak, 0))
}

# ---- tendency -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Ordinary least squares slope of y over 1..n.
ols_slope <- function(y) {
  n <- length(y)
  if (n < 2) return(0)
  x <- seq_len(n)
  sum((x - mean(x)) * (y - mean(y))) / sum((x - mean(x))^2)
}

# Tendency of the recent play.
# @return list(balance = "rising"/"falling"/"steady", slope_pct (balance % per
#   100 plays), bet = "increasing"/"decreasing"/"stable", bet_change,
#   chase (mean bet after a loss / after a win), chase_label, streak, rtp, window)
stats_tendency <- function(tk, window = 100L) {
  n <- length(tk$bal)
  idx <- utils::tail(seq_len(n), window)
  bal <- tk$bal[idx]
  slope <- ols_slope(bal)
  lvl <- max(1, mean(bal))
  slope_pct <- if (length(bal) >= 2) 100 * slope * 100 / lvl else 0
  balance <- if (length(bal) < 10) "unknown" else if (slope_pct > 2) "rising" else if (slope_pct < -2) "falling" else "steady"

  w <- tk$wager; paid <- which(w > 0)
  recent <- utils::tail(paid, 50); prev <- utils::tail(setdiff(paid, recent), 50)
  bet_change <- if (length(recent) >= 10 && length(prev) >= 10) mean(w[recent]) / mean(w[prev]) - 1 else 0
  bet <- if (length(recent) < 10 || length(prev) < 10) "unknown" else if (bet_change > 0.15) "increasing"
         else if (bet_change < -0.15) "decreasing" else "stable"

  chase <- chase_ratio(w, tk$net)
  chase_label <- if (is.na(chase)) "unknown" else if (chase > 1.15) "chasing" else if (chase < 0.87) "cautious" else "even"

  # current streak of winning (net > 0) or losing (net < 0) paid plays
  res <- sign(tk$net[paid])
  streak <- 0L
  if (length(res)) {
    last <- res[length(res)]
    k <- length(res)
    while (k >= 1 && res[k] == last) k <- k - 1L
    streak <- as.integer((length(res) - k) * last)
  }
  wr <- sum(w[idx]); rtp <- if (wr > 0) sum(w[idx] + tk$net[idx]) / wr else NA_real_
  list(balance = balance, slope_pct = slope_pct, bet = bet, bet_change = bet_change,
       chase = chase, chase_label = chase_label, streak = streak, rtp = rtp, window = length(idx),
       net = sum(tk$net[idx]))
}

# Mean bet after a losing play divided by the mean bet after a winning play.
chase_ratio <- function(wager, net, min_n = 5L) {
  n <- length(wager)
  if (n < 2) return(NA_real_)
  prev <- net[-n]; nxt <- wager[-1]
  ok <- nxt > 0 & wager[-n] > 0
  al <- nxt[ok & prev < 0]; aw <- nxt[ok & prev > 0]
  if (length(al) < min_n || length(aw) < min_n) return(NA_real_)
  mean(al) / mean(aw)
}

# ---- category ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

STAKE_CLASSES <- data.frame(
  min = c(0, 500, 2500, 10000, 50000),
  label = c("Micro stakes", "Low stakes", "Mid stakes", "High stakes", "VIP stakes"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

stake_class <- function(avg_bet) STAKE_CLASSES$label[max(which(STAKE_CLASSES$min <= max(0, avg_bet)))]

# Favourite category (largest share of wagered coins), stake class and style.
stats_category <- function(tk) {
  wc <- tk$wager_cat
  tot <- sum(wc)
  share <- if (tot > 0) wc / tot else wc
  fav <- if (tot > 0) names(which.max(wc)) else if (sum(tk$plays_cat) > 0) names(which.max(tk$plays_cat)) else NA_character_
  table_share <- sum(share[STAT_TABLE_CATS])
  style <- if (tot <= 0) "unknown" else if (table_share >= 0.65) "tables" else if (table_share <= 0.2) "slots" else "allround"
  paid <- tk$wager[tk$wager > 0]
  avg <- if (length(paid)) mean(paid) else 0
  list(favourite = fav, share = share, style = style, avg_bet = avg,
       stake = if (length(paid)) stake_class(avg) else NA_character_)
}

# ---- features & classification ------------------------------------------------------------

STAT_FEATURES <- c(bet = "Average bet", pace = "Plays per minute", risk = "High-risk share",
                   table = "Table-game share", escalation = "Bet escalation after losses")

# Numeric behaviour features, or NULL with fewer than STAT_MIN_PLAYS plays.
stats_features <- function(tk) {
  n <- length(tk$bal)
  if (n < STAT_MIN_PLAYS) return(NULL)
  w <- tk$wager
  paid <- w[w > 0]
  bet <- log10(max(1, if (length(paid)) mean(paid) else 1))
  g <- diff(tk$t)
  g <- g[g >= 0]
  active_min <- sum(pmin(g, STAT_IDLE_SECS)) / 60
  pace <- if (active_min > 0) min(40, length(g) / active_min) else 40
  tot <- sum(tk$wager_cat)
  risk <- if (tot > 0) min(1, tk$risky / tot) else 0
  table <- if (tot > 0) sum(tk$wager_cat[STAT_TABLE_CATS]) / tot else 0
  ch <- chase_ratio(w, tk$net)
  esc <- if (is.na(ch)) 0 else max(-1, min(1, log(ch)))
  c(bet = bet, pace = pace, risk = risk, table = table, escalation = esc)
}

# Player archetypes: centre of each feature (see STAT_FEATURES) and the spread
# used to generate the synthetic training set.
ARCHETYPES <- data.frame(
  id = c("casual", "grinder", "thrill", "roller", "shark"),
  label = c("Casual Spinner", "Grinder", "Thrill Seeker", "High Roller", "Card Shark"),
  icon = c("\U0001F388", "\u2699\uFE0F", "\U0001F3A2", "\U0001F48E", "\U0001F988"),
  desc = c("Small bets at a relaxed pace - playing for the fun of it.",
           "Fast, steady volume at modest stakes. The machines know you well.",
           "Chases the big hits: high-volatility machines and double-or-nothing gambles.",
           "Big stakes, measured pace. The VIP room is yours.",
           "Prefers the tables - skill and strategy over spinning reels."),
  bet = c(2.6, 3.0, 3.5, 4.6, 3.5),
  pace = c(4, 14, 9, 6, 4),
  risk = c(0.3, 0.25, 0.75, 0.4, 0.1),
  table = c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.3, 0.8),
  escalation = c(0, 0, 0.25, 0.05, -0.05),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ARCHETYPE_SD <- c(bet = 0.35, pace = 3, risk = 0.15, table = 0.12, escalation = 0.1)

.stats_cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

# Synthetic labelled reference set: `per` players around each archetype.
# Deterministic and RNG-free (so it never touches the session's random stream):
# every feature uses the normal quantiles qnorm((1:per - 0.5) / per), visited in
# a different order per feature (a stratified, Latin-hypercube style sample),
# then clipped to the valid range of the feature. Cached.
archetype_reference <- function(per = 60L) {
  key <- as.character(per)
  if (!is.null(.stats_cache$ref[[key]])) return(.stats_cache$ref[[key]])
  f <- names(ARCHETYPE_SD)
  z <- stats::qnorm((seq_len(per) - 0.5) / per)
  steps <- c(7L, 11L, 13L, 17L, 19L, 23L, 29L, 31L)          # coprime with typical `per`
  steps <- steps[per %% steps != 0]
  perm <- function(k, i) ((seq_len(per) - 1L) * steps[k] + 3L * i + k) %% per + 1L
  ref <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(ARCHETYPES)), function(i) {
    m <- vapply(seq_along(f), function(k) ARCHETYPES[[f[k]]][i] + ARCHETYPE_SD[[f[k]]] * z[perm(k, i)], numeric(per))
    colnames(m) <- f
    data.frame(m, label = ARCHETYPES$id[i], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  ref$bet <- pmin(5.5, pmax(1.5, ref$bet)); ref$pace <- pmin(40, pmax(0.5, ref$pace))
  ref$risk <- pmin(1, pmax(0, ref$risk)); ref$table <- pmin(1, pmax(0, ref$table))
  ref$escalation <- pmin(1, pmax(-1, ref$escalation))
  if (is.null(.stats_cache$ref)) .stats_cache$ref <- list()
  .stats_cache$ref[[key]] <- ref
  ref
}

# Standardisation (centre/scale) learned from the reference set.
feature_scaler <- function(ref = archetype_reference()) {
  f <- names(ARCHETYPE_SD)
  list(center = colMeans(ref[f]), scale = apply(ref[f], 2, stats::sd))
}
scale_features <- function(x, sc = feature_scaler()) {
  if (is.null(dim(x))) x <- rbind(x)                   # a single named vector
  x <- as.matrix(x)[, names(sc$center), drop = FALSE]
  sweep(sweep(x, 2, sc$center), 2, sc$scale, "/")
}

# k-nearest-neighbours classification (Euclidean distance on standardised
# features, majority vote; ties broken by the summed inverse distance).
# @param x named numeric feature vector (or a matrix of rows)
# @return list(label, confidence (vote share), votes (named), neighbours)
knn_classify <- function(x, ref = archetype_reference(), k = 9L) {
  sc <- feature_scaler(ref)
  f <- names(ARCHETYPE_SD)
  X <- scale_features(ref[f], sc)
  q <- scale_features(x[f], sc)
  d <- sqrt(rowSums(sweep(X, 2, q[1, ])^2))
  nn <- order(d)[seq_len(min(k, nrow(X)))]
  labs <- ref$label[nn]
  votes <- table(factor(labs, levels = ARCHETYPES$id))
  weight <- tapply(1 / (d[nn] + 1e-9), factor(labs, levels = ARCHETYPES$id), sum)
  weight[is.na(weight)] <- 0
  best <- names(votes)[order(-as.numeric(votes), -as.numeric(weight))][1]
  list(label = best, confidence = as.numeric(votes[best]) / length(nn),
       votes = stats::setNames(as.numeric(votes), names(votes)), distance = mean(d[nn]))
}

# Archetype row for an id.
archetype <- function(id) ARCHETYPES[ARCHETYPES$id == id, , drop = FALSE]

# Deterministic k-means initialisation ("farthest point"): start from the
# player nearest the overall centre, then repeatedly add the player farthest
# from the centres chosen so far. Same data -> same clusters, no RNG needed.
farthest_point_centers <- function(X, k) {
  d2 <- function(p) rowSums(sweep(X, 2, p)^2)
  idx <- which.min(d2(colMeans(X)))
  dmin <- d2(X[idx, ])
  while (length(idx) < k) {
    nxt <- which.max(dmin)
    idx <- c(idx, nxt)
    dmin <- pmin(dmin, d2(X[nxt, ]))
  }
  X[idx, , drop = FALSE]
}

# k-means clustering of a community of players.
# @param feats data.frame with the feature columns (+ player_id)
# @param k clusters (default: between 2 and 4, about one per 4 players)
# @return NULL if there are fewer than `min_players`; else list(cluster (per
#   row), centers (original units), size, label (nearest archetype per cluster))
community_clusters <- function(feats, k = NULL, min_players = 8L) {
  f <- names(ARCHETYPE_SD)
  if (is.null(feats) || nrow(feats) < min_players) return(NULL)
  feats <- feats[stats::complete.cases(feats[f]), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(feats) < min_players) return(NULL)
  sc <- feature_scaler()
  X <- scale_features(feats[f], sc)
  k <- k %||% max(2L, min(4L, nrow(X) %/% 4L))
  k <- min(k, nrow(unique(round(X, 6))))
  if (k < 2) return(NULL)
  km <- stats::kmeans(X, centers = farthest_point_centers(X, k), iter.max = 50)
  centers <- sweep(sweep(km$centers, 2, sc$scale, "*"), 2, sc$center, "+")
  labels <- apply(centers, 1, function(cn) knn_classify(stats::setNames(cn, f))$label)
  list(cluster = unname(km$cluster), centers = centers, size = as.integer(km$size),
       label = unname(labels), player_id = feats$player_id %||% NULL,
       betweenss = km$betweenss / km$totss)
}

# ---- the full report ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Everything the stats page shows, from a track and the current balance.
# @param session list(t0 = start time) of the current session, or NULL
stats_report <- function(tk, coins, now = now_secs(), session = NULL) {
  f <- stats_features(tk)
  cls <- if (is.null(f)) NULL else knn_classify(f)
  wagered <- sum(tk$wager_cat)
  cur_dd <- max(0, tk$peak - coins)
  list(
    plays = tk$n, wagered = wagered,
    active = tk$active,
    online = tk$online + if (!is.null(session)) max(0, now - session$t0) else 0,
    peak = tk$peak, max_dd = tk$max_dd, max_dd_pct = tk$max_dd_pct,
    cur_dd = cur_dd, cur_dd_pct = if (tk$peak > 0) cur_dd / tk$peak else 0,
    tendency = stats_tendency(tk), category = stats_category(tk),
    features = f, class = cls, need = max(0L, STAT_MIN_PLAYS - length(tk$bal)))
}

# ---- SVG balance chart --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Balance line with running peak and the drawdown area shaded (inline SVG).
stats_balance_svg <- function(bal, width = 1000, height = 280, pad = 40) {
  if (length(bal) < 2) return(NULL)
  ds <- drawdown_series(bal)
  n <- length(bal)
  lo <- min(bal); hi <- max(ds$peak)
  if (hi - lo < 1) { hi <- hi + 1; lo <- lo - 1 }
  X <- function(i) pad + (i - 1) / (n - 1) * (width - 2 * pad)
  Y <- function(v) height - pad - (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * (height - 2 * pad)
  xy <- function(i, v) sprintf("%.1f,%.1f", X(i), Y(v))
  pts <- function(v) paste(xy(seq_len(n), v), collapse = " ")
  esc <- htmltools::htmlEscape
  up <- bal[n] >= bal[1]
  grid_v <- pretty(c(lo, hi), 4)
  grid_v <- grid_v[grid_v >= lo & grid_v <= hi]
  grid <- paste(sprintf('<line class="sc-grid" x1="%d" x2="%d" y1="%.1f" y2="%.1f"/><text class="sc-axis" x="2" y="%.1f">%s</text>',
                        pad, width - pad, Y(grid_v), Y(grid_v), Y(grid_v) + 4, esc(fmt_short(grid_v))), collapse = "")
  fill <- paste(c(xy(seq_len(n), bal), sprintf("%.1f,%d", X(n), height - pad), sprintf("%.1f,%d", X(1), height - pad)), collapse = " ")
  dd_area <- paste(c(xy(seq_len(n), ds$peak), rev(xy(seq_len(n), ds$bal))), collapse = " ")
  worst <- which.max(ds$dd)
  # label the worst drawdown beside the middle of its marker (left of it near the right edge)
  right <- X(worst) > width * 0.62
  mark <- if (ds$dd[worst] > 0) sprintf(
    '<line class="sc-ddmark" x1="%.1f" x2="%.1f" y1="%.1f" y2="%.1f"/><text class="sc-ddtext" x="%.1f" y="%.1f" text-anchor="%s">%s</text>',
    X(worst), X(worst), Y(ds$peak[worst]), Y(ds$bal[worst]), X(worst) + if (right) -8 else 8,
    (Y(ds$peak[worst]) + Y(ds$bal[worst])) / 2 + 4, if (right) "end" else "start",
    esc(tr("max drawdown -%s", fmt_short(ds$dd[worst])))) else ""
  col <- if (up) "#1fd18b" else "#ff4d6d"
  HTML(paste0(
    sprintf('<svg class="stats-chart" viewBox="0 0 %d %d" role="img" aria-label="%s">', width, height, esc(tr("Balance history"))),
    sprintf('<defs><linearGradient id="fcBalFill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0%%" stop-color="%s" stop-opacity=".35"/><stop offset="100%%" stop-color="%s" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient></defs>', col, col),
    grid,
    sprintf('<polygon class="sc-fill" points="%s"/>', fill),
    sprintf('<polygon class="sc-dd" points="%s"/>', dd_area),
    sprintf('<polyline class="sc-peak" points="%s"/>', pts(ds$peak)),
    sprintf('<polyline class="sc-line %s" points="%s"/>', if (up) "up" else "down", pts(bal)),
    mark,
    sprintf('<circle class="sc-dot %s" cx="%.1f" cy="%.1f" r="4"/>', if (up) "up" else "down", X(n), Y(bal[n])),
    sprintf('<text class="sc-axis" x="%d" y="%d">%s</text>', pad, height - 8, esc(tr("%d plays ago", n - 1L))),
    sprintf('<text class="sc-axis" x="%d" y="%d" text-anchor="end">%s</text>', width - pad, height - 8, esc(tr("now"))),
    '</svg>'))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# fct_storage.R -- persistent data.
#
# Backends (see app_config.R):
#   "sqlite"  : an SQLite database (DBI + RSQLite). Player profiles, the
#               server-wide linked jackpot pots and a play log survive app
#               restarts. The browser only keeps an anonymous player id.
#   "memory"  : the same interface kept in R memory (tests, demos).
#   "browser" : no server storage; the profile is saved in localStorage.
#
# Every backend returns the same list of functions, so the rest of the app
# never talks to the database directly. Database errors are converted into
# warnings and never crash a session.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

FC_SCHEMA_VERSION <- 2L

# Tables (created if missing). Version 2 added players.name/features,
# plays.balance/category and the sessions table; fc_db_migrate() upgrades
# version-1 databases in place.
FC_SCHEMA <- c(
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS players (
     player_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     state      TEXT NOT NULL,
     coins      REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
     level      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
     avatar     TEXT,
     lang       TEXT,
     created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
     updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
     name       TEXT,
     features   TEXT)",
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jackpots (
     tier       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     value      REAL NOT NULL,
     updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)",
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plays (
     id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     player_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     ts        TEXT NOT NULL,
     family    TEXT NOT NULL,
     game      TEXT NOT NULL,
     wager     REAL NOT NULL,
     win       REAL NOT NULL,
     balance   REAL,
     category  TEXT)",
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jackpot_wins (
     id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     player_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     ts        TEXT NOT NULL,
     tier      TEXT NOT NULL,
     amount    REAL NOT NULL)",
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
     id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     player_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
     started_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
     ended_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
     seconds       REAL NOT NULL,
     start_balance REAL,
     end_balance   REAL,
     plays         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)"
)

# Columns added after version 1: table -> c(column = type).
FC_SCHEMA_COLUMNS <- list(
  players = c(name = "TEXT", features = "TEXT"),
  plays = c(balance = "REAL", category = "TEXT")
)

# Indexes (created after the migration, as they use the new columns).
FC_SCHEMA_INDEXES <- c(
  "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plays_player ON plays (player_id, ts)",
  "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_players_name ON players (name COLLATE NOCASE)",
  "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_player ON sessions (player_id, started_at)"
)

FC_SQL <- list(
  load_player = "SELECT state FROM players WHERE player_id = ?",
  save_player = paste(
    "INSERT INTO players (player_id, state, coins, level, avatar, lang, created_at, updated_at, name, features)",
    "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
    "ON CONFLICT(player_id) DO UPDATE SET state = excluded.state, coins = excluded.coins,",
    "level = excluded.level, avatar = excluded.avatar, lang = excluded.lang, updated_at = excluded.updated_at,",
    "name = excluded.name, features = COALESCE(excluded.features, players.features)"),
  find_player_by_name = "SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 1",
  log_play = "INSERT INTO plays (player_id, ts, family, game, wager, win, balance, category) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
  log_session = paste("INSERT INTO sessions (player_id, started_at, ended_at, seconds, start_balance, end_balance, plays)",
                      "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)"),
  player_sessions = paste("SELECT started_at, ended_at, seconds, start_balance, end_balance, plays FROM sessions",
                          "WHERE player_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?"),
  all_features = paste("SELECT player_id, name, features FROM players WHERE features IS NOT NULL",
                       "ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ?"),
  load_jackpots = "SELECT tier, value FROM jackpots",
  save_jackpot = paste(
    "INSERT INTO jackpots (tier, value, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
    "ON CONFLICT(tier) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value, updated_at = excluded.updated_at"),
  jackpot_won = "INSERT INTO jackpot_wins (player_id, ts, tier, amount) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
  leaderboard = "SELECT player_id, name, coins, level, avatar FROM players ORDER BY coins DESC LIMIT ?",
  player_totals = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays, COALESCE(SUM(wager), 0) AS wagered, COALESCE(SUM(win), 0) AS won FROM plays WHERE player_id = ?"
)

fc_now_iso <- function() format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")
fc_iso <- function(secs) format(as.POSIXct(secs, origin = "1970-01-01"), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")

# ---- player names ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Tidy a typed name: trim and collapse inner whitespace.
fc_clean_name <- function(x) {
  if (!is.character(x) || length(x) != 1 || is.na(x)) return("")
  gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(x))
}
# A valid player name: 2-20 letters (any alphabet), digits, spaces, dots,
# dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
fc_valid_name <- function(x) {
  is.character(x) && length(x) == 1 && !is.na(x) && nchar(x) >= 2 && nchar(x) <= 20 &&
    grepl("^[\\p{L}\\p{N}][\\p{L}\\p{N} ._-]*$", x, perl = TRUE)
}

# ---- SQLite primitives -------------------------------------------------------------

# Open (and create / migrate) a database.
fc_db_connect <- function(path = fc_db_path()) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DBI", quietly = TRUE) || !requireNamespace("RSQLite", quietly = TRUE))
    stop("The 'sqlite' storage backend needs the DBI and RSQLite packages.", call. = FALSE)
  if (!identical(path, ":memory:")) dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), path)
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
  if (!identical(path, ":memory:")) DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
  fc_db_init(con)
  con
}

fc_db_init <- function(con) {
  for (sql in FC_SCHEMA) DBI::dbExecute(con, sql)
  fc_db_migrate(con)
  for (sql in FC_SCHEMA_INDEXES) DBI::dbExecute(con, sql)
  DBI::dbExecute(con, sprintf("PRAGMA user_version = %d", FC_SCHEMA_VERSION))
  invisible(con)
}

# Add the columns introduced after schema version 1 to an older database.
fc_db_migrate <- function(con) {
  for (tbl in names(FC_SCHEMA_COLUMNS)) {
    have <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("PRAGMA table_info(%s)", tbl))$name
    add <- FC_SCHEMA_COLUMNS[[tbl]]
    for (col in setdiff(names(add), have))
      DBI::dbExecute(con, sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s ADD COLUMN %s %s", tbl, col, add[[col]]))
  }
  invisible(con)
}

fc_db_load_player <- function(con, player_id) {
  r <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, FC_SQL$load_player, params = list(player_id))
  if (!nrow(r)) return(NULL)
  jsonlite::fromJSON(r$state[1], simplifyVector = FALSE)
}

# @param features optional named numeric behaviour features (fct_stats.R)
fc_db_save_player <- function(con, player_id, snapshot, lang = "en", features = NULL) {
  json <- as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(snapshot, auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null", digits = NA))
  name <- fc_clean_name(snapshot$name %||% "")
  feat <- if (length(features)) as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(as.list(features), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 6)) else NA_character_
  now <- fc_now_iso()
  params <- function(nm) list(
    player_id, json, as.numeric(snapshot$coins %||% 0), as.integer(snapshot$level %||% 1L),
    as.character(snapshot$avatar %||% ""), as.character(lang), now, now, nm, feat)
  # A name taken by another player (race between two sessions) must not lose
  # the save: keep the profile, without the name.
  tryCatch(DBI::dbExecute(con, FC_SQL$save_player, params = params(if (nzchar(name)) name else NA_character_)),
           error = function(e) {
             if (!grepl("UNIQUE", conditionMessage(e), ignore.case = TRUE)) stop(e)
             DBI::dbExecute(con, FC_SQL$save_player, params = params(NA_character_))
           })
  invisible(TRUE)
}

fc_db_find_player_by_name <- function(con, name) {
  r <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, FC_SQL$find_player_by_name, params = list(fc_clean_name(name)))
  if (!nrow(r)) NULL else r$player_id[1]
}

fc_db_log_play <- function(con, player_id, family, game, wager, win, balance = NA, category = NA) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con, FC_SQL$log_play, params = list(
    player_id, fc_now_iso(), family, game, as.numeric(wager), as.numeric(win),
    as.numeric(balance %||% NA), as.character(category %||% NA)))
  invisible(TRUE)
}

fc_db_log_session <- function(con, player_id, started, ended, seconds, start_balance, end_balance, plays) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con, FC_SQL$log_session, params = list(
    player_id, fc_iso(started), fc_iso(ended), as.numeric(seconds), as.numeric(start_balance),
    as.numeric(end_balance), as.integer(plays)))
  invisible(TRUE)
}

fc_db_player_sessions <- function(con, player_id, n = 10L) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, FC_SQL$player_sessions, params = list(player_id, as.integer(n)))
}

# Behaviour features of the most recently active players (community clustering).
fc_db_all_features <- function(con, n = 500L) {
  r <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, FC_SQL$all_features, params = list(as.integer(n)))
  fc_features_frame(r$player_id, r$name, lapply(r$features, function(j)
    tryCatch(unlist(jsonlite::fromJSON(j)), error = function(e) NULL)))
}

# data.frame(player_id, name, <features>) from parallel lists.
fc_features_frame <- function(ids, names, feats) {
  f <- names(ARCHETYPE_SD)
  ok <- vapply(feats, function(x) !is.null(x) && all(f %in% names(x)), logical(1))
  if (!any(ok)) return(data.frame(player_id = character(0), name = character(0)))
  m <- do.call(rbind, lapply(feats[ok], function(x) as.numeric(x[f])))
  colnames(m) <- f
  data.frame(player_id = as.character(ids[ok]), name = as.character(names[ok]), m, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

fc_db_load_jackpots <- function(con) {
  r <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, FC_SQL$load_jackpots)
  if (!nrow(r)) return(NULL)
  pots <- JACKPOT_SEEDS
  hit <- intersect(r$tier, names(pots))
  pots[hit] <- r$value[match(hit, r$tier)]
  pots
}

fc_db_save_jackpots <- function(con, pots) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con, FC_SQL$save_jackpot, params = list(
    names(pots), as.numeric(pots), rep(fc_now_iso(), length(pots))))
  invisible(TRUE)
}

fc_db_jackpot_won <- function(con, player_id, tier, amount) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con, FC_SQL$jackpot_won, params = list(player_id, fc_now_iso(), tier, as.numeric(amount)))
  invisible(TRUE)
}

fc_db_leaderboard <- function(con, n = 10L) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, FC_SQL$leaderboard, params = list(as.integer(n)))
}

fc_db_player_totals <- function(con, player_id) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, FC_SQL$player_totals, params = list(player_id))
}

# ---- shared connections ---------------------------------------------------------------
.fc_db <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

# One connection per database file per R process (Shiny is single-threaded),
# re-opened transparently if it was closed.
fc_db_shared <- function(path = fc_db_path()) {
  con <- .fc_db$cons[[path]]
  if (is.null(con) || !DBI::dbIsValid(con)) {
    con <- fc_db_connect(path)
    if (is.null(.fc_db$cons)) .fc_db$cons <- list()
    .fc_db$cons[[path]] <- con
  }
  con
}

fc_db_close_all <- function() {
  for (con in .fc_db$cons) try(DBI::dbDisconnect(con), silent = TRUE)
  .fc_db$cons <- list()
  invisible(TRUE)
}

# ---- storage interface -------------------------------------------------------------------

# Run a storage operation; on failure warn and return `default`.
fc_safely <- function(expr, default = NULL) {
  tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) {
    warning("fortuneCougar storage: ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
    default
  })
}

# Create a storage backend. Every backend exposes the same functions:
#   load_player(id), save_player(id, snapshot, lang, features),
#   find_player_by_name(name) -> player id or NULL,
#   log_play(id, family, game, wager, win, balance, category),
#   log_session(id, started, ended, seconds, start_balance, end_balance, plays),
#   player_sessions(id, n), all_features(n),
#   load_jackpots(), save_jackpots(pots), jackpot_won(id, tier, amount),
#   leaderboard(n), player_totals(id)
fc_storage <- function(backend = fc_storage_backend(), path = fc_db_path()) {
  backend <- match.arg(backend, c("sqlite", "memory", "browser"))
  if (backend == "sqlite") {
    con <- function() fc_db_shared(path)
    return(list(
      backend = "sqlite", path = path, server_side = TRUE,
      load_player = function(id) fc_safely(fc_db_load_player(con(), id)),
      save_player = function(id, snapshot, lang = "en", features = NULL)
        fc_safely(fc_db_save_player(con(), id, snapshot, lang, features), FALSE),
      find_player_by_name = function(name) fc_safely(fc_db_find_player_by_name(con(), name)),
      log_play = function(id, family, game, wager, win, balance = NA, category = NA)
        fc_safely(fc_db_log_play(con(), id, family, game, wager, win, balance, category), FALSE),
      log_session = function(id, started, ended, seconds, start_balance, end_balance, plays)
        fc_safely(fc_db_log_session(con(), id, started, ended, seconds, start_balance, end_balance, plays), FALSE),
      player_sessions = function(id, n = 10L) fc_safely(fc_db_player_sessions(con(), id, n)),
      all_features = function(n = 500L) fc_safely(fc_db_all_features(con(), n)),
      load_jackpots = function() fc_safely(fc_db_load_jackpots(con())),
      save_jackpots = function(pots) fc_safely(fc_db_save_jackpots(con(), pots), FALSE),
      jackpot_won = function(id, tier, amount) fc_safely(fc_db_jackpot_won(con(), id, tier, amount), FALSE),
      leaderboard = function(n = 10L) fc_safely(fc_db_leaderboard(con(), n)),
      player_totals = function(id) fc_safely(fc_db_player_totals(con(), id))
    ))
  }
  if (backend == "memory") {
    m <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
    m$players <- list(); m$meta <- list(); m$plays <- list(); m$jackpots <- NULL; m$wins <- list()
    m$sessions <- list()
    return(list(
      backend = "memory", path = NULL, server_side = TRUE, env = m,
      load_player = function(id) m$players[[id]],
      save_player = function(id, snapshot, lang = "en", features = NULL) {
        name <- fc_clean_name(snapshot$name %||% "")
        if (nzchar(name)) {
          other <- Filter(function(k) !identical(k, id) && identical(tolower(m$meta[[k]]$name %||% ""), tolower(name)), names(m$meta))
          if (length(other)) name <- ""                     # taken: keep the profile, without the name
        }
        m$players[[id]] <- snapshot
        m$meta[[id]] <- list(coins = snapshot$coins %||% 0, level = snapshot$level %||% 1L,
                             avatar = snapshot$avatar %||% "", lang = lang, name = name,
                             features = if (length(features)) features else m$meta[[id]]$features)
        TRUE
      },
      find_player_by_name = function(name) {
        name <- tolower(fc_clean_name(name))
        hit <- Filter(function(k) identical(tolower(m$meta[[k]]$name %||% ""), name), names(m$meta))
        if (nzchar(name) && length(hit)) hit[1] else NULL
      },
      log_play = function(id, family, game, wager, win, balance = NA, category = NA) {
        m$plays[[length(m$plays) + 1]] <- list(player_id = id, family = family, game = game, wager = wager, win = win,
                                               balance = balance, category = category)
        TRUE
      },
      log_session = function(id, started, ended, seconds, start_balance, end_balance, plays) {
        m$sessions[[length(m$sessions) + 1]] <- list(player_id = id, started_at = fc_iso(started), ended_at = fc_iso(ended),
                                                     seconds = seconds, start_balance = start_balance,
                                                     end_balance = end_balance, plays = plays)
        TRUE
      },
      player_sessions = function(id, n = 10L) {
        s <- rev(Filter(function(x) identical(x$player_id, id), m$sessions))
        if (!length(s)) return(data.frame(started_at = character(0), seconds = numeric(0)))
        utils::head(do.call(rbind, lapply(s, function(x) as.data.frame(x[-1], stringsAsFactors = FALSE))), n)
      },
      all_features = function(n = 500L) {
        ids <- utils::head(names(m$meta), n)
        fc_features_frame(ids, vapply(ids, function(k) m$meta[[k]]$name %||% "", ""),
                          lapply(ids, function(k) m$meta[[k]]$features))
      },
      load_jackpots = function() m$jackpots,
      save_jackpots = function(pots) { m$jackpots <- pots; TRUE },
      jackpot_won = function(id, tier, amount) { m$wins[[length(m$wins) + 1]] <- list(id, tier, amount); TRUE },
      leaderboard = function(n = 10L) {
        if (!length(m$meta)) return(data.frame(player_id = character(0), name = character(0), coins = numeric(0),
                                               level = integer(0), avatar = character(0)))
        d <- data.frame(player_id = names(m$meta),
                        name = vapply(m$meta, function(x) { v <- x$name %||% ""; if (nzchar(v)) v else NA_character_ }, ""),
                        coins = vapply(m$meta, function(x) as.numeric(x$coins), 0),
                        level = vapply(m$meta, function(x) as.integer(x$level), 0L),
                        avatar = vapply(m$meta, function(x) as.character(x$avatar), ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        utils::head(d[order(-d$coins), , drop = FALSE], n)
      },
      player_totals = function(id) {
        p <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$player_id, id), m$plays)
        data.frame(plays = length(p), wagered = sum(vapply(p, `[[`, 0, "wager")), won = sum(vapply(p, `[[`, 0, "win")))
      }
    ))
  }
  nothing <- function(...) NULL
  list(backend = "browser", path = NULL, server_side = FALSE,
       load_player = nothing, save_player = nothing, find_player_by_name = nothing, log_play = nothing,
       log_session = nothing, player_sessions = nothing, all_features = nothing, load_jackpots = nothing,
       save_jackpots = nothing, jackpot_won = nothing, leaderboard = nothing, player_totals = nothing)
}

# A valid player id: 8-64 letters, digits or dashes (generated by the browser).
fc_valid_player_id <- function(id) {
  is.character(id) && length(id) == 1 && !is.na(id) && grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,64}$", id)
}

fc_new_player_id <- function() {
  paste(sample(c(0:9, letters[1:6]), 32, replace = TRUE), collapse = "")
}

      div(class = "hud-coins", title = tr("Coins"),

      div(class = "hud-stars", title = tr("Stars (Star Market)"), "\u2B50", span(id = "hud-stars", "25")),
      div(class = "hud-vip", id = "hud-vip", title = tr("Playtika Rewards status"), paste("\U0001F949", tr("Bronze"))),
      tags$button(type = "button", class = "hud-turbo", id = "hud-turbo", title = tr("Turbo animations (T)"),
                  onclick = "FC.toggleTurbo()", "\u26A1"),
      # language switch: shows the *other* language
      if (fc_lang() == "pt_BR")
        tags$button(type = "button", class = "hud-lang", title = "Switch to English", onclick = "FC.setLang('en')", "\U0001F1FA\U0001F1F8 EN")
      else
        tags$button(type = "button", class = "hud-lang", title = "Mudar para portugu\u00eas", onclick = "FC.setLang('pt_BR')", "\U0001F1E7\U0001F1F7 PT"))
}

hud_server <- function(id, player) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    observe({
      rv <- player$rv
      v <- player$vip()
      lvl <- rv$level
      session$sendCustomMessage("fc_hud", list(
        coins = rv$coins, level = lvl, xp_pct = round(100 * rv$xp / xp_needed(lvl), 1),
        stars = floor(rv$stars), vip = paste(VIP_TIERS$icon[v$index], tr(v$tier)),
        vip_color = VIP_TIERS$color[v$index], avatar = rv$avatar,
        name = if (nzchar(rv$name)) rv$name else tr("Guest")))
    })
    observeEvent(input$profile, player$go("rewards"))
    observeEvent(input$stats, player$go("stats"))
  })
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# mod_roulette.R -- European / American / French / Multi-Wheel roulette.
# Engine: engine_roulette.R. The betting layout is generated here with a hit
# zone for every inside bet (straights, splits, streets, corners, six-lines,
# zero trios, first-four / basket); chips are painted client side.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

RL_CHIPS <- c(100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000)
RL_RULES_TEXT <- c(
  european = "Single-zero wheel (37 pockets) \u2022 house edge 2.70% \u2022 straight 35:1, split 17:1, street 11:1, corner 8:1, six-line 5:1",
  american = "0 and 00 wheel (38 pockets) \u2022 house edge 5.26% \u2022 extra 0-00 split and the 0-00-1-2-3 basket (6:1)",
  french = "Single zero with LA PARTAGE: even-money bets return half on zero (edge 1.35% on those bets) \u2022 announced bets available",
  multi = "One set of bets plays on up to 6 European wheels spinning together - total stake = bets \u00D7 wheels")

rl_key <- function(type, nums) paste0(type, ":", paste(sort(nums), collapse = "-"))
rl_n <- function(c, r) 3 * c - (r - 1)          # column 1..12, row 1 (top) .. 3

# SVG roulette wheel for a variant.
roulette_wheel_svg <- function(id, variant, size = 300) {
  order <- rl_wheel(variant)
  n <- length(order)
  r <- size / 2; cx <- r; cy <- r; seg <- 360 / n
  fill <- c(red = "#c0142b", black = "#15121c", green = "#0d8a3e")
  pockets <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    a0 <- (i - 1) * seg - 90 - seg / 2; a1 <- a0 + seg
    p <- function(rad, a) c(cx + rad * cos(a * pi / 180), cy + rad * sin(a * pi / 180))
    o0 <- p(r - 6, a0); o1 <- p(r - 6, a1); i0 <- p(r * 0.62, a0); i1 <- p(r * 0.62, a1)
    tp <- p(r * 0.83, (a0 + a1) / 2)
    sprintf(paste0('<path d="M%.2f,%.2f L%.2f,%.2f A%.2f,%.2f 0 0,1 %.2f,%.2f L%.2f,%.2f A%.2f,%.2f 0 0,0 %.2f,%.2f Z" fill="%s" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="0.8"/>',
                   '<text x="%.2f" y="%.2f" fill="#fff" font-size="%.1f" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" transform="rotate(%.2f %.2f %.2f)">%s</text>'),
            i0[1], i0[2], o0[1], o0[2], r - 6, r - 6, o1[1], o1[2], i1[1], i1[2], r * 0.62, r * 0.62, i0[1], i0[2],
            fill[[rl_color(order[i])]], tp[1], tp[2], size / 26, (a0 + a1) / 2 + 90, tp[1], tp[2], rl_label(order[i]))
  }, "")
  spokes <- paste(vapply(0:3, function(k) sprintf('<line x1="%.1f" y1="%.1f" x2="%.1f" y2="%.1f" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="3"/>',
                                                  cx, cy, cx + r * 0.45 * cos(k * pi / 2), cy + r * 0.45 * sin(k * pi / 2)), ""), collapse = "")
  div(class = "rl-wheel", id = id, `data-n` = n, style = sprintf("width:%dpx;height:%dpx", size, size),
      HTML(sprintf(paste0('<svg viewBox="0 0 %d %d" width="%d" height="%d"><circle cx="%.1f" cy="%.1f" r="%.1f" fill="#3b2314" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="5"/>',
                          '<g class="rl-rotor">%s<circle cx="%.1f" cy="%.1f" r="%.1f" fill="#5a3820" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="2"/>%s',
                          '<circle cx="%.1f" cy="%.1f" r="%.1f" fill="#d4af37"/></g></svg>'),
                   size, size, size, size, cx, cy, r - 1, paste(pockets, collapse = ""), cx, cy, r * 0.6, spokes, cx, cy, r * 0.08)),
      div(class = "rl-ball-track", div(class = "rl-ball")),
      div(class = "rl-result-bubble"))
}

# The betting layout with every hit zone.
roulette_table_ui <- function(ns, variant) {
  click <- function(key) js_set(ns("place"), sprintf("{key: '%s', n: Math.random()}", key))
  spot <- function(key, left, top, cls = "rl-spot", label = NULL) {
    div(class = cls, `data-key` = key, onclick = click(key), title = rl_bet_label(key),
        style = sprintf("left:%.3f%%;top:%.3f%%", left, top), label)
  }
  cells <- list(); spots <- list()
  for (c in 1:12) for (r in 1:3) {
    n <- rl_n(c, r)
    cells[[length(cells) + 1]] <- div(
      class = paste("rl-num", rl_color(n)), `data-key` = rl_key("straight", n), onclick = click(rl_key("straight", n)),
      title = paste(tr("Straight up"), n), style = sprintf("grid-column:%d;grid-row:%d", c, r), span(n))
    if (r < 3) spots[[length(spots) + 1]] <- spot(rl_key("split", c(n, rl_n(c, r + 1))), (c - 0.5) / 12 * 100, r / 3 * 100, "rl-spot split-v")
    if (c < 12) spots[[length(spots) + 1]] <- spot(rl_key("split", c(n, rl_n(c + 1, r))), c / 12 * 100, (r - 0.5) / 3 * 100, "rl-spot split-h")
    if (c < 12 && r < 3) spots[[length(spots) + 1]] <- spot(rl_key("corner", c(n, rl_n(c, r + 1), rl_n(c + 1, r), rl_n(c + 1, r + 1))),
                                                           c / 12 * 100, r / 3 * 100, "rl-spot corner")
  }
  for (c in 1:12) {
    spots[[length(spots) + 1]] <- spot(rl_key("street", (3 * c - 2):(3 * c)), (c - 0.5) / 12 * 100, 100, "rl-spot street")
    if (c < 12) spots[[length(spots) + 1]] <- spot(rl_key("sixline", (3 * c - 2):(3 * c + 3)), c / 12 * 100, 100, "rl-spot sixline")
  }
  # bets touching the zero(s)
  if (variant == "american") {
    zs <- list(spot(rl_key("split", c(37, 3)), 0, 100 / 6, "rl-spot zero"),
               spot(rl_key("street", c(37, 2, 3)), 0, 100 / 3, "rl-spot zero"),
               spot(rl_key("split", c(37, 2)), 0, 44, "rl-spot zero"),
               spot(rl_key("street", c(0, 37, 2)), 0, 50, "rl-spot zero trio"),
               spot(rl_key("split", c(0, 2)), 0, 56, "rl-spot zero"),
               spot(rl_key("street", c(0, 1, 2)), 0, 200 / 3, "rl-spot zero"),
               spot(rl_key("split", c(0, 1)), 0, 500 / 6, "rl-spot zero"),
               spot(rl_key("basket", c(0, 37, 1, 2, 3)), 0, 100, "rl-spot zero basket"))
    zero_col <- div(class = "rl-zero double",
                    div(class = "rl-num green", `data-key` = "straight:37", onclick = click("straight:37"), span("00")),
                    div(class = "rl-num green", `data-key` = "straight:0", onclick = click("straight:0"), span("0")),
                    spot(rl_key("split", c(0, 37)), 50, 50, "rl-spot split-zero"))
  } else {
    zs <- list(spot(rl_key("split", c(0, 3)), 0, 100 / 6, "rl-spot zero"),
               spot(rl_key("street", c(0, 2, 3)), 0, 100 / 3, "rl-spot zero"),
               spot(rl_key("split", c(0, 2)), 0, 50, "rl-spot zero"),
               spot(rl_key("street", c(0, 1, 2)), 0, 200 / 3, "rl-spot zero"),
               spot(rl_key("split", c(0, 1)), 0, 500 / 6, "rl-spot zero"),
               spot(rl_key("corner", c(0, 1, 2, 3)), 0, 100, "rl-spot zero basket"))
    zero_col <- div(class = "rl-zero",
                    div(class = "rl-num green", `data-key` = "straight:0", onclick = click("straight:0"), span("0")))
  }
  outside <- function(key, label, cls = "") div(class = paste("rl-out", cls), `data-key` = key, onclick = click(key), span(label))
  div(class = paste("rl-table", variant), id = ns("table"),
      zero_col,
      div(class = "rl-grid", cells, spots, zs),
      div(class = "rl-cols", outside("col3", "2:1"), outside("col2", "2:1"), outside("col1", "2:1")),
      div(class = "rl-dozens", outside("dozen1", tr("1st 12")), outside("dozen2", tr("2nd 12")), outside("dozen3", tr("3rd 12"))),
      div(class = "rl-outside",
          outside("low", "1-18"), outside("even", tr("EVEN")), outside("red", "\u25C6", "red"),
          outside("black", "\u25C6", "black"), outside("odd", tr("ODD")), outside("high", "19-36")))
}

roulette_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  div(class = "table-game roulette",
      page_header(tr("Roulette"), tr("Single zero, double zero, La Partage - and up to six wheels at once."), icon = "\U0001F3A1"),
      div(class = "variant-pills",
          radioButtons(ns("variant"), NULL, choiceNames = tr(unname(RL_VARIANTS)), choiceValues = names(RL_VARIANTS), inline = TRUE)),
      div(class = "rules-line", uiOutput(ns("rules"))),
      div(class = "rl-layout",
          div(class = "rl-wheel-area",
              uiOutput(ns("wheels")),
              div(class = "rl-last", id = ns("last"), div(class = "rl-last-empty", tr("Place your bets!"))),
              div(class = "rl-history", id = ns("history"))),
          div(class = "rl-board",
              uiOutput(ns("table")),
              uiOutput(ns("call_bets")),
              div(class = "table-controls",
                  div(class = "bet-row",
                      div(class = "bet-chips",
                          span(class = "ctl-label", tr("CHIP")),
                          lapply(RL_CHIPS, function(v) tags$button(
                            type = "button", class = paste("chip", chip_color(v), if (v == 1000) "selected"),
                            `data-chip` = v, onclick = paste0("FC.selectChip(this);", js_set(ns("chip"), v)), fmt_short(v)))),
                      uiOutput(ns("multi_ctl"))),
                  div(class = "action-row",
                      actionButton(ns("undo"), tr("UNDO"), class = "btn-act"),
                      actionButton(ns("clear"), tr("CLEAR"), class = "btn-act"),
                      actionButton(ns("rebet"), tr("REBET"), class = "btn-act"),
                      actionButton(ns("double"), tr("DOUBLE"), class = "btn-act"),

roulette_server <- function(id, player) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    ns <- session$ns
    st <- reactiveValues(variant = "european", bets = numeric(0), stack = list(), last_bets = numeric(0),
                         chip = 1000, wheels = 1L, history = integer(0), spinning_until = 0)
    n_wheels <- reactive(if (st$variant == "multi") st$wheels else 1L)
    wheel_variant <- function(v) if (v == "multi") "european" else v

    push_chips <- function() {
      session$sendCustomMessage("fc_chips", list(table = ns("table"), bets = as.list(isolate(st$bets))))
    }

    observeEvent(input$variant, {
      st$variant <- input$variant
      st$bets <- numeric(0); st$stack <- list(); st$history <- integer(0)
    }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
    observeEvent(input$chip, { st$chip <- input$chip })
    observeEvent(input$n_wheels, { st$wheels <- as.integer(input$n_wheels) })

    place <- function(keys_amounts) {
      v <- isolate(st$variant)
      b <- isolate(st$bets)
      stake_now <- sum(b); add <- sum(keys_amounts)
      mx <- BET_LADDER[player$max_bet_index()] * 10
      if (stake_now + add > mx) {
        player$toast(tr("Table limit"), tr("Max total stake at your level is %s", fmt_coins(mx)), "warning", "\U0001F512")
        return(FALSE)
      }
      if ((stake_now + add) * isolate(n_wheels()) > player$coins()) {
        player$toast(tr("Not enough coins"), tr("Your bets exceed your balance."), "warning", "\U0001FA99"); return(FALSE)
      }
      for (k in names(keys_amounts)) {
        if (!rl_valid(k, wheel_variant(v)) && !(k %in% names(OUTSIDE_BETS))) next
        b <- rl_add_bet(b, k, keys_amounts[[k]])
      }
      st$stack <- c(isolate(st$stack), list(isolate(st$bets)))
      st$bets <- b
      push_chips()
      TRUE
    }

    observeEvent(input$place, {
      place(stats::setNames(isolate(st$chip), input$place$key))
    })
    observeEvent(input$call, {
      cb <- RL_CALL_BETS[[input$call$id]]
      place(cb$chips * isolate(st$chip))
    })
    observeEvent(input$undo, {
      s <- st$stack
      if (length(s)) { st$bets <- s[[length(s)]]; st$stack <- s[-length(s)]; push_chips() }
    })
    observeEvent(input$clear, { st$stack <- c(st$stack, list(st$bets)); st$bets <- numeric(0); push_chips() })
    observeEvent(input$rebet, {
      if (length(st$last_bets)) { st$bets <- numeric(0); place(st$last_bets) }
    })
    observeEvent(input$double, { if (length(st$bets)) place(st$bets) })

    observeEvent(input$spin, {
      if (now_secs() < isolate(st$spinning_until)) return()
      bets <- isolate(st$bets)
      if (!length(bets)) { player$toast(tr("No bets"), tr("Click the layout to place chips."), "warning", "\U0001F3A1"); return() }
      v <- isolate(st$variant); nw <- isolate(n_wheels()); wv <- wheel_variant(v)
      stake <- sum(bets) * nw
      if (!player$debit(stake)) { player$toast(tr("Not enough coins"), tr("Remove some chips."), "warning", "\U0001FA99"); return() }
      results <- vapply(seq_len(nw), function(i) rl_spin(wv), numeric(1))
      settles <- lapply(results, function(res) rl_settle(bets, res, v))
      ret <- sum(vapply(settles, `[[`, numeric(1), "total"))
      player$credit(ret)
      order <- rl_wheel(wv)
      dur <- 4200
      st$spinning_until <- now_secs() + 1.2     # no double spins while the wheel turns
      st$history <- utils::head(c(rev(results), isolate(st$history)), 18)
      st$last_bets <- bets
      straight_hits <- sum(vapply(settles, function(s) sum(grepl("^straight:", s$lines$bet) & s$lines$returned > 0), numeric(1)))

      result_html <- as.character(tagList(
        div(class = "rl-last-nums", lapply(results, function(x)
          span(class = paste("rl-ball-num", rl_color(x)), rl_label(x)))),
        div(class = paste("rl-net", if (ret - stake > 0) "up" else if (ret - stake < 0) "down"),
            if (ret > 0) tr("Returned %s", fmt_coins(ret)) else tr("No winning bets"),
            span(paste0(" (", tr("net %s", paste0(if (ret - stake >= 0) "+" else "-", fmt_coins(abs(ret - stake)))), ")"))),
        div(class = "rl-win-lines", lapply(seq_along(settles), function(w) {
          l <- settles[[w]]$lines; l <- l[l$returned > 0, , drop = FALSE]
          lapply(seq_len(nrow(l)), function(i) div(sprintf("%s%s: %s", if (nw > 1) paste0(tr("W%d", w), " \u2022 ") else "",
                                                           rl_bet_label(l$bet[i]), l$note[i]),
                                                   span(fmt_coins(l$returned[i]))))
        }))))
      history_html <- as.character(tagList(lapply(isolate(st$history), function(x)
        span(class = paste("rl-hist", rl_color(x)), rl_label(x)))))

      session$sendCustomMessage("fc_roulette", list(
        wheels = lapply(seq_len(nw), function(i) list(id = ns(paste0("wheel", i)),
                                                      index = match(results[i], order) - 1L,
                                                      n = length(order), label = rl_label(results[i]),
                                                      color = rl_color(results[i]))),
        duration = dur, last = ns("last"), history = ns("history"),
        result_html = result_html, history_html = history_html))
      if (ret >= 20 * sum(bets) && ret > 0) player$celebrate(win_tier(ret, stake), ret, tr("ROULETTE WIN!"), tr(RL_VARIANTS[[v]]), delay = dur)
      player$record("roulette", v, NULL, wager = stake, win = ret, bet = stake,
                    metrics = c(rl_spins = nw, rl_straight = straight_hits))
    })

    output$rules <- renderUI(span(tr(RL_RULES_TEXT[[st$variant]])))

    output$wheels <- renderUI({
      nw <- n_wheels(); wv <- wheel_variant(st$variant)
      size <- if (nw == 1) 320 else if (nw <= 2) 220 else if (nw <= 4) 160 else 130
      div(class = paste("rl-wheels", paste0("n", nw)),
          lapply(seq_len(nw), function(i) roulette_wheel_svg(ns(paste0("wheel", i)), wv, size)))
    })
    output$table <- renderUI({
      ui <- roulette_table_ui(ns, wheel_variant(st$variant))
      session$onFlushed(push_chips, once = TRUE)
      ui
    })
    output$call_bets <- renderUI({
      if (st$variant != "french") return(NULL)
      div(class = "call-bets",
          span(class = "ctl-label", tr("ANNOUNCED BETS")),
          lapply(names(RL_CALL_BETS), function(k) {
            cb <- RL_CALL_BETS[[k]]
            tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn-call", onclick = js_set(ns("call"), sprintf("{id: '%s', n: Math.random()}", k)),
                        cb$label, span(tr("%d chips", as.integer(sum(cb$chips)))))
          }))
    })
    output$multi_ctl <- renderUI({
      if (st$variant != "multi") return(NULL)
      div(class = "multi-ctl", span(class = "ctl-label", tr("WHEELS")),
          radioButtons(ns("n_wheels"), NULL, choices = 1:6, selected = isolate(st$wheels), inline = TRUE))
    })
    output$stake <- renderUI({
      s <- sum(st$bets); nw <- n_wheels()
      tagList(span(class = "bet-amount", fmt_coins(s * nw)),
              span(class = "bet-sub", if (nw > 1) tr("%s \u00D7 %d wheels", fmt_coins(s), nw) else trn(length(st$bets), "%d bet", "%d bets", length(st$bets))))
    })
    invisible(st)
  })
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# mod_slot_category.R -- a slot category page: a lobby of machine tiles plus
# every machine of the category (one slot_machine module instance each),
# switched with a hidden navset so machine state survives navigation.
# Used by mod_classic_slots.R, mod_myth_slots.R and mod_animal_slots.R.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

slot_category_ui <- function(id, category, title, subtitle, icon) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  games <- slots_in(category)
  lobby <- nav_panel_hidden(
    "lobby",
    page_header(tr(title), tr(subtitle), icon = icon,
                right = span(class = "ph-count", tr("%d machines", length(games)))),
    div(class = "tile-grid",
        lapply(games, function(d) game_tile(d, js_set(ns("open"), sprintf("'%s'", d$id)))))
  )
  machines <- lapply(games, function(d) nav_panel_hidden(
    d$id,
    div(class = "machine-nav",
        tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn-back", onclick = js_set(ns("open"), "'lobby'"),
                    "\u2190 ", tr(title)),
        div(class = "machine-switch",
            lapply(games, function(o) tags$button(
              type = "button", class = paste("ms-pill", if (o$id == d$id) "active"),
              title = o$name, onclick = js_set(ns("open"), sprintf("'%s'", o$id)), HTML(o$art))))),
    slot_machine_ui(ns(d$id), d)
  ))
  do.call(navset_hidden, c(list(lobby), unname(machines), list(id = ns("view"))))
}

slot_category_server <- function(id, category, tab, player, linked = NULL) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    games <- slots_in(category)
    machines <- lapply(games, function(d)
      slot_machine_server(d$id, d, player, linked = if (d$id == "bankjackpots") linked else NULL))
    names(machines) <- vapply(games, `[[`, "", "id")

    observeEvent(input$open, {
      nav_select("view", input$open)
    })
    # deep links from the lobby / other modules: player$go(tab, game)
    observeEvent(player$rv$nav, {
      n <- player$rv$nav
      if (identical(n$tab, tab) && !is.null(n$game) && n$game %in% names(machines)) {
        nav_select("view", n$game)
      }
    })
    invisible(machines)
  })
}
